name: Card
description: `Card` is a composable content container with heading, description, image, metadata, icon, and action parts.

props.name: action
props.description: Supplies the action region. Takes precedence over a matching `Card.Action` child.

props.name: as
props.description: Element to render. Use `section` when the card is a labelled region of the page.

props.name: description
props.description: Supplies the description region. Takes precedence over a matching `Card.Description` child.

props.name: heading
props.description: Supplies the heading region. Takes precedence over a matching `Card.Heading` child.

props.name: icon
props.description: Supplies the icon region. Takes precedence over a matching `Card.Icon` child.

props.name: image
props.description: Supplies the image region. Takes precedence over a matching `Card.Image` child.

props.name: layout
props.description: Use `compact` to lay the card out in a row rather than stacked.

props.name: metadata
props.description: Supplies the metadata region. Takes precedence over a matching `Card.Metadata` child.

props.name: as
props.description: Heading element to render, so the card heading fits the surrounding document outline.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name for the icon. Leave unset when the icon is decorative.
